avis.titre: Caused irritation and sensitivity - SO BUMMED
avis.texte: I used this product religiously several years ago. After using a sample for a few weeks at the beginning of the year I purchased a full bottle. I had noticeable results pretty quickly. However, with continued use my skin became more and more sensitive after having been well balanced for years. I couldn't even use SPF on my face or other origins favorites as I was developing a chronic itchy, blotch rash specifically around the T zone. The itchiness and rash has calmed down significantly after not using this product for a week. I didn't have this issue in the past so maybe there has been a change in ingredients? Either way I'm so bummed as I recently replenished and have a brand new bottle I now won't use.

I like the product, but there are plenty of other good serums out there.

avis.titre: Have you changed the scent on my favorite Origins item?

I honestly will not be as inclined to buy it, if so...it's expensive, and that was such a key element of why I liked it so much. Interested to know what happened...

avis.titre: I get ID'd again when buying alcohol…
avis.texte: I was very skeptical of this product at first..nothing can really make your skin look younger and decrease wrinkles right? WRONG! I got this as a free product as part of a promotion a while ago and never consistently used it until recently. I am only 24 years old but have some forehead wrinkles and loss of skin elasticity overall. I was considering getting Botox due to it being one of my insecurities and figured I'd try this serum I found in the bottom of my drawer as a last shot. When I tell you every time I go out or buy alcohol I get ID'd and they ask me to verify my name/birthday/address I'm not kidding! I never got ID'd, let alone questioned about my age! I thought it was a fluke at first but consistently I have been asked AND I have noticed a decrease in wrinkles and improved skin elasticity over the past two weeks of 2x/ day use! I am 100000% purchasing this again.
